profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Nvidia
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer hardware industry. Skilled in Python (Programming Language), C++, Jenkins, Microprocessors, and C (Programming Language). Strong engineering professional graduated from Purdue University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and creator of NVIDIA OSMO: A cloud native compute orchestration tool to bring MLOps to robotics.

Our team manages thousands of GPUs in various public clouds, and on the edge. We enable researchers to run robotics workflows like RL, simulation, synthetic data generation, and supervised learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded software engineer working with camera input on autonomous vehicle platform.
- Create drivers and APIs to control Camera Modules and SerDes link.
- Develop applications in both C and C++ to demonstrate Image Handling APIs
- Automate regression testing using Jenkins, Bash, and Python
- Follow industry standard processes for developing safe, automotive software.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed clock tree control firmware for GPU.
- Wrote code in C for a very memory restricted environment.
- Created test harness to validate code by simulating hardware registers.
- Created data structures to represent the clock tree and dynamically program registers to reach the desired clock frequency.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Full stack web development for personal health dashboard web app.
- Designed relational database schema to handle health data from diverse sources (Microsoft HealthVault, Apple HealthKit, Google Fit)
- Developed python scripts to authenticate with Google Fit APIs and obtain user data.
- Programmed REST APIs using Django framework to query and modify data.
- Create front end health dashboards using Bootstrap CSS, JavaScript, and HTML.
